title: Stepanov determinant
note: Timeline 1 (10/6/26): 'Stepanov determinant'. Page 1: the argument descends from Stepanov's proof of RH over function fields, which uses a divisor with multiplicity; multiplicity is hard to find over the integers.

title: Invariant derivation on a CM curve
note: Timeline 2 (10/9/26): D^p = 0 on a CM curve for p inert in K, D the invariant derivation, and D^a theta(0) / Omega^a divisible by p^(a/p + a/p^3 + ... - O(log a)).

title: qN = M^k + R sign argument
note: Timeline 3 (10/19/26+) and footnote 3: qN = M^k + R using the 'path' quadric x_1 x_2 + ... + x_{k-1} x_k; sum over h, x_1..x_k of t(x_1)...t(x_k) e_q(h(x_1 x_2 + ... + x_{k-1} x_k)); Bertini gives a definite sign from middle cohomology; R of square-root quality by iterating Parseval k times; 'automorphy' of N since mu is automorphic from theta on the sixfold cover of GL5; Poincare bundle on the edges of a CM curve such as C/Z[omega] to get thetas. A 'sign-only proof of Weil and Deligne'.

title: W(1_S) >= 0 via a determinant; bootstrap
note: Timeline 4 (10/6/26+): W(1_S) >= 0 via a determinant, interpreted as Stepanov with multiplicity one again; bootstrap.

title: Switch to the von Mangoldt sum; Guinand-Weil sign
note: Timeline 5 (10/20/26): definitively switch to Lambda, i.e. sum_{n<=X} Lambda(n) (X/n - 1)_+ - X log X + (1 + gamma) X; Guinand-Weil had the sign; variance test-function trick to make things look trace-formula-like; Mehta-like integral over twists or at infinity.

title: W(1_(0,1] + X^eta 1_(0,1/X]) >= 0 gives > 1 - eta
hint: Reads as a zero-free region statement.

title: Determinants of GGP periods; interlacing
note: Timeline 7 (10/14/26): determinants for W(.)'s containing the desired periods, indeed GGP periods, with values 0, 1 meaning interlacing weights, or up to m non-interlacing ones.

title: Iterated theta lifts, multiplicity m ~ sqrt(X)
note: Timeline 8 (11/15/26): iterated theta lifts U(X_0) -> U(X_1) -> ... -> U(X_m) between totally definite unitary groups, pi -> pi [+] mu_j[t], wins multiplicity m. Take m like sqrt(X). Page 1: for the von Mangoldt sum of length X the chain length is sqrt(X).

title: Norms of lifts; Chowla-Selberg, Weyl, Siegel mass
note: Timeline 9 (11/15/26): norms of the lifts and level, and cancellation of order-m terms with proven divisibility via Chowla-Selberg, Weyl, and Siegel mass.

title: Lower bound on divisibility of the m-fold lift
note: Timeline 10 (11/15/26): sufficient lower bound on divisibility of the m-fold iterated lift.

title: Iwasawa tower via pigeonhole
note: Timeline 11 (10/6/26): Iwasawa tower via analogy to pigeonhole on F_{q^n}/F_q.
hint: An Iwasawa tower is a tower of number fields such as cyclotomic Z_p-extensions, not the Iwasawa decomposition G = KAN of a group.

title: Seesaw: period of the lift is a Bessel period (Rallis)
note: Timeline 12 (11/15/26): seesaw: the period of the iterated lift is a Bessel period independent of the Hecke characters (Rallis).

title: Bost slope inequality
note: Timeline 13 (10/6/26): Bost slope inequality.

title: Cost of each lift; the 2/3 barrier; division
note: Timeline 14 (11/15/26): precise computation of the 'cost' of each lift, showing one would stop at 2/3 a priori; attempt to get a main term and transfer the constant to a function field or kill it via twisting; need for 'division'.

title: Integral structure across Hecke characters (gcd)
note: Timeline 15 (11/15/26): glue together an integral structure across Hecke characters for a 'gcd', i.e. extra averaging.

title: Relative trace formula; projected Poincare series
note: Timeline 16 (10/14/26): relative trace formula, seen in a different half-plane argument via the sixfold cover of GL5 automorphy of mu, reducing via Cauchy-Schwarz to a bound on the norm of a suitably projected Poincare series; approximate orthogonality of the columns of the integral structure.

title: Weakening of Vandiver's conjecture
note: Timeline 17 (11/15/26): for the classes in H^1(o_E[1/l], Q_l/Z_l(-e)) that could not be killed by twisting, prove a significant weakening of Vandiver's conjecture (implies vanishing of a number of K-groups of Z).

title: Covolumes, theta series index, congruences
note: Timeline 18 (11/15/26): computation of covolumes, theta series' index, congruences between lifts and forms.

title: Choice of Iwasawa tower using Behrend
note: Timeline 19 (10/19/26): precise choice of the Iwasawa tower, using Behrend; footnote: 'obviously going to be unnecessary'.
hint: Behrend's construction gives large sets of integers without 3-term arithmetic progressions.

title: Multiplicity 2 on O(2,n) via a natively automorphic determinant
note: Page 3: 'once we saw multiplicity 2 on O(2, n) via the natively-automorphic determinant that I'd been searching for via analogy to the definite sign of the left-hand side of qN = M^k + R ... winning more multiplicity with more theta lifts, we were going to win'.

title: Normalized Gauss sum on the |mu_K|-fold cover of GL2
note: Footnote 3: averaging over the family chi -> chi(disc), corresponding to a -> y(.)^a with y the normalized Gauss sum of order #|mu_K| living via theta on the #|mu_K|-fold cover of GL2; the reciprocity law of y(c c') vs y(c) y(c') gives a complete graph, simplified to the 'path' quadric; Gauss-sum cancellation replaced by iterated Parseval.
